Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Affidavit / Undertaking: The bidder shall submit a scanned copy of an undertaking on e-Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, duly notar ized in the prescribed format, declaring that the firm has not been debarred/blacklisted by any Government Department/PSU/Autonomous Body as on the date of submission of Bid. Conditional / Ambiguous Bids: Conditional Bids shall be rejected outright. Bids containing material ambiguity or deviation from the NIT conditions shall also be liable to rejection. 6. Submission of Documents: All documents submitted with the Technical Bid shall be clear, legible, readable and complete. Non- submission of mandatory documents or submission of illegible documents may render the bid liable to rejection. 8. Compliance with DJB Conditions: The bidder shall comply with the General Conditions of Contract, NIT conditions and applicable circul ars/orders/instructions issued by Delhi Jal Board from time to time. 9. Any penalty/liability arising due to non-compliance shall be borne by the con tracting agency. 10. Submission of the bid shall be deem ed to imply that the bidder has understood the site conditions and scope of work. 11. DJB shall not be responsible for any loss, claim or liability attributable to the cont ractor's operations, subject to applicable law and contractual provisions. 12. If any information/document furnished by the bidder is found to be false, fabricated or misleading at any stage, appropriate action shall be taken against the firm as per applicable DJB rules/contract co nditions, including rejection/termination/debarment, as applicable. 15. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The bidder shall deposit EMD amounting to Rs. 19500/- in favour of EE(E&M) M-17, Delhi Jal B oard, in the prescribed mode, and proof thereof shall be submitted with the Technical Bid. Non-sub mission of the prescribed EMD, unless exempted under applicable rules, shall render the bid liable t o rejection. 16. Additional Performance Guarantee: If the quoted amount/rates attract the requirement of Additional Performance Guarantee under the applicable DJB rules/NIT provisions, including where the quoted rates are more than 25% below the departmental justified rates, the successful bidder shall submit the prescribed Additional Performan ce Guarantee before execution of the contract. The PG shall be furnished in favour of EE(E&M) M- 17, Delhi Jal Board, as per applicable departmental provisions. 17. Completion Period: The supply/work covered under the Bid shall be completed within 60 days from the date stipulated i n the Work Order/Supply Order. 18. Guarantee Period: The material/equipment supplied shall carry a Guarantee Period of 12 months from the date of satisfactory completion/commissioning/acceptance, as applicable under the contract. 19. Procurement Documents: The firm shall submit duly signed and stamped copies of genuine procurement documents/purchase vouchers/invoices relating to the material supplied/procured under the contract, wherever required under DJB conditions. 20. Documents with Bill: At the time of submission of the bill, the firm shall submit the applicable supporting documents, incl uding defaced purchase vouchers/invoices, Test Certificates, Challans and E-Way Bills, wh erever applicable. The challan shall be duly acknowledged/signed by the Site In-charge in supply ca ses. The firm shall be solely responsible for the authenticity of all such documents submitted with t he running/final bill. 21. Payment: Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion and acceptance of the supply/work a nd submission of all requisite documents, subject to the terms and conditions of the contract and av ailability of applicable approvals/budget. 22. GST: Payment/reimbursement of GST shall be regulated as per applicable Government rules and Delhi Jal Board terms and conditions. 23. Intimation of Delivery: In supply cases, the firm shall intimate the delivery of material to the office of EE(E&M) M-17 throu gh e-mail at eeemm17.djb@gmail.com 24. immediately after delivery. 25. IP Address Condition: Bidders are advised not to submit bids for two or more different firms from the same IP address. If participation of two or more firms from the same IP address is detected, the bids shall be dealt wit h as per applicable e-procurement/DJB rules and may be liable to rejection. 26. Departmental Rights: Delhi Jal Board reserves the right to verify the credentials, statutory registrations, authorization certi ficates, procurement documents, invoices, test certificates and other documents submitted by the bidder at any stage and to take appropriate action in case of any discrepancy, misrepresentation or non-compliance. .
